title: Insights into the DNA and RNA Interactions of Human Topoisomerase III Beta Using Molecular Dynamics Simulations
author: Chapagain, Prem
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0

steps.title: Run hTOP3 molecular dynamics simulations
steps.instruction: Perform molecular dynamics simulations of human Topoisomerase IIIβ (hTOP3) with DNA and RNA substrates that are either covalently or non‑covalently bound.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a simulation system for covalently bound DNA substrate with hTOP3.
Prepare a simulation system for non‑covalently bound DNA substrate with hTOP3.
Prepare a simulation system for covalently bound RNA substrate with hTOP3.
Prepare a simulation system for non‑covalently bound RNA substrate with hTOP3.
Run each simulation for a total of 300 ns, saving coordinates every 1 ns (resulting in 300 frames per simulation).
